description: Where each bundled Noto fallback face comes from. A face with a 'source' is a subset that tools/fallback_font_subsets.py cuts from that upstream file (verified by its sha256); 'characters' names the character set the script documents. A face without a 'source' is the unmodified upstream file. Licence: SIL OFL 1.1 (OFL-Noto.txt, OFL-NotoSansCJKjp.txt).

NotoSansCJKjp-Subset.otf.characters: kana, JIS X 0208 (non-kanji, levels 1 and 2), Japanese punctuation and width forms; Japanese forms (locl JAN baked into the cmap)

NotoSansCJKkr-Subset.otf.characters: all 11,172 Hangul syllables, the Hangul jamo, KS X 1001 with its 4,888 hanja; Korean forms (locl KOR baked into the cmap)

NotoSansCJKsc-Minimal.otf.characters: the GB 2312 level 1 hanzi the Japanese and Korean faces lack; Simplified Chinese forms (locl ZHS baked into the cmap)

NotoSansArabic-Minimal.ttf.characters: basic letters, digits and punctuation, no presentation forms and no layout tables

NotoSansDevanagari-Minimal.ttf.characters: the script's main block and the dandas, no conjunct glyphs and no layout tables

NotoSansBengali-Minimal.ttf.characters: the script's main block and the dandas, no conjunct glyphs and no layout tables

NotoSansGurmukhi-Minimal.ttf.characters: the script's main block and the dandas, no conjunct glyphs and no layout tables
